title: Credit Scoring Observability
description: Pipeline health, infrastructure stability and model drift alerts for the credit scoring model.

panels.title: Failed pipeline steps
panels.description: Steps whose latest run raised an error (step_failed event).

panels.title: Critical alerts firing
panels.description: Prometheus alerts currently firing with severity critical.

panels.title: Warning alerts firing
panels.description: Prometheus alerts currently firing with severity warning.

panels.title: Drifted features (latest month)
panels.description: Features with PSI >= 0.10 in the most recent production month.

panels.title: Latest month checked
panels.description: Most recent production month analysed by the drift check.

panels.title: Last pipeline push
panels.description: When the pipeline last pushed its metrics to the Pushgateway.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Prometheus alerting rules currently firing (monitoring/prometheus/rules.yml). Drift alerts refer to the latest production month.

panels.title: Latest run status per step
panels.description: 1 = the step's latest run finished successfully, 0 = it raised an error.

panels.title: Step duration (latest run)
panels.description: Wall-clock time of each step's latest run.

panels.title: Rows processed (latest run)
panels.description: Sum of the rows reported by the events of each step's latest run.

panels.title: Step runs by outcome
panels.description: Executions per step and outcome in logs/pipeline.jsonl.

panels.title: Ingestion gate: batches
panels.description: Batches accepted or rejected (and quarantined) by the scoring data contract.

panels.title: Contract failures by check (latest rejected batch)
panels.description: Failure cases per Pandera check in the latest batch blocked by the ingestion gate.

panels.title: Raw data curation
panels.description: Raw rows, exact duplicates removed, rows rejected by the labeled contract, curated rows kept.

panels.title: Monitoring targets
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape each component of the monitoring stack.

panels.title: Host memory used
panels.description: Memory in use on the host running the stack.

panels.title: Data disk used
panels.description: Space used on the disk that holds the Prometheus and Pushgateway data.

panels.title: CPU cores
panels.description: Logical CPUs available to the host.

panels.title: Host uptime
panels.description: Time since the host booted.

panels.title: Host CPU usage
panels.description: Share of CPU time not idle. Alert above 90% for 5 minutes.

panels.title: Host memory usage
panels.description: Share of memory in use. Alert above 90% for 5 minutes.

panels.title: Peak memory per step (latest run)
panels.description: Peak resident memory of the Python process that ran each step.

panels.title: Feature drift: PSI by month
panels.description: Population Stability Index of each feature against the reference dataset. Orange: drift (>= 0.10). Red: major drift (>= 0.25).

panels.title: Drift and degradation alerts per month
panels.description: Alerts raised by the drift check (reports/drift/alerts.json). 2026-01 is the control month.

panels.title: Model performance (observed outcomes)
panels.description: ROC AUC and recall per month. Reference holdout: ROC AUC 0.936, recall 0.710. Alerts at drops of 0.05 (AUC) and 0.10 (recall).

panels.title: Calibration: observed vs. predicted default rate
panels.description: When the observed default rate exceeds the predicted rate by 5 pp or more, the model is underestimating risk.

panels.title: Prediction and target drift (PSI)
panels.description: PSI of the predicted default probability and of the observed label against the reference holdout. Alert at 0.10.

panels.title: Recall: data drift alone vs. with concept drift (simulation ground truth)
panels.description: Only available in this simulation: outcomes recomputed without the concept drift injection. The gap is the damage done by concept drift.

panels.title: Scoring latency per monthly batch
panels.description: Time to validate a monthly batch against the scoring contract and score it (latest scoring run).
